explanation: The statement says that every element of the residue-field span of the cotangent images of z i is the image of some y in the ideal generated by the z i. This is stated for the library's own definitions cotSpan and idealSpan. I searched Mathlib's Ideal/Cotangent.lean and grepped for toCotangent combined with span or mem. The only related results were mem_toCotangent_ker, toCotangent_eq_zero and a spanning-set criterion around line 337 of Cotangent.lean. None of them gives this lifting statement, and none follows from it in one or two lines.
